title: A record ID matches the ID pattern
statement: A record ID MUST match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$`.

title: A title is not blank
statement: A title MUST NOT be empty or only spaces.

title: A statement is not blank
statement: A statement MUST NOT be empty or only spaces.

title: A statement states its rule with MUST, SHOULD or MAY
statement: A statement SHOULD state its rule in full using MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD or MAY, under a title that is the rule in a few words.

title: A position is a whole number from 1
statement: A position MUST be a whole number from 1.

title: A path is not blank
statement: A path MUST NOT be empty or only spaces.

title: An identifier is lower case with underscores
statement: An identifier MUST be lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

title: A subdomain type is core, supporting or generic
statement: A subdomain type MUST be `core`, `supporting` or `generic`.

title: An entity's role is root or child
statement: An entity's role MUST be `root` or `child`.

title: A basic type is one of seven
statement: A basic type MUST be text, whole number, decimal, date, time, date and time, or yes/no.

title: A table's storage is one of six
statement: A table's storage MUST be `table`, `view`, `materialized view`, `browser storage`, `file` or `in memory`.

title: A key is primary, unique, foreign or an index
statement: A table key's type MUST be `primary`, `unique`, `foreign` or `index`.

title: A method is an HTTP method
statement: An endpoint's method MUST be GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS.

title: An event is delivered in process or by outbox
statement: An event type's delivery MUST be `in process` or `outbox`.

title: A level is one of five
statement: A run by's level MUST be unit, integration, service, system or browser.

title: A state is automated, manual or not automated yet
statement: A run by's state MUST be `automated`, `manual` or `not automated yet`.

title: An automated test names its file
statement: An automated run by MUST name the file that runs it, relative to the repo root.

title: Only a manual test gives a manual reason
statement: A manual run by MUST give its reason, and any other MUST NOT.

title: A kind field is text, integer, boolean or date
statement: A product kind field's type MUST be `text`, `integer`, `boolean` or `date`.

title: A stage is one of the six
statement: A stage MUST be discovery, domain-model, use-cases, interaction-design, technical-specification or test-plan.

title: A relation's role is design or proof
statement: A relation's role, when it has one, MUST be `design` or `proof`.

title: Groups compare trimmed and in any letter case
statement: Two group names MUST be one group when they are equal trimmed and in any letter case.

title: A check name is lower-case words joined by hyphens
statement: A check name MUST be lower-case letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, such as `too-many-children`.

title: A check severity is error, warning or error_or_warning
statement: A check severity MUST be `error`, `warning`, or `error_or_warning` when the check's query says which for each row.

title: A children limit is a whole number of at least 1
statement: A children limit MUST be a whole number of at least 1; the store refuses any other value, naming the table.

title: A binding is written as chords the keymap reads
statement: A binding MUST be one chord, or chords separated by spaces, each its modifiers then one key joined by `+`, and is kept in the keymap's normal form.

title: A binding never takes a browser's essential key
statement: No binding, default or overridden, MAY take Cmd/Ctrl+W, T, L, R, N or Q, Tab, F5 or F11, or a key reserved for the browser on the current platform (Ctrl+G off a Mac).

title: Token values name known tokens, each with a value of its kind
statement: Token values MUST name only tokens of the app's token table, each with a value that is exactly a value of its kind, and MUST NOT carry selectors, rules or any other text.

title: A theme file says its format and version and holds known fields only
statement: A theme file MUST be JSON with `format` "lathe-theme", `version` 1, a `name` of 1 to 60 characters, and `light`, `dark` and `tokens` objects. A file with any other field MUST be refused with a message saying why.

title: Window chrome is exactly two opaque hex colors
statement: Window chrome MUST be exactly `{ background, foreground }`, each an opaque hex color (`#rgb` or `#rrggbb`); anything else is refused and changes nothing.

title: One address per thing
statement: A record's address MUST be its bare ID (`/<id>`), a product's and a domain's included, and a group's its place in the graph's tree: a stage at `/<domain-id>/<stage>` and a kind group at `/<parent-id>/<kind>`. The app's own pages MUST be lowercase words (`/`, `/format`, `/settings/appearance`), and a space's Checks page its product's ID and a word (`/LA/checks`), so no ID, which starts with a capital, can take their address. There is no second address for anything.

title: The stage is named only in the query
statement: An address MUST name its stage only in its `stage` query parameter (`?stage=erd`), never in its path, so the stage never changes the path.

title: A stage is Graph, ERD or Trace
statement: A stage MUST be exactly one of `graph`, `erd` and `trace`; a value naming none of them MUST be read as no stage, which shows the graph.

title: Depth is 1 to 3, and the layout is one of three
statement: A graph's depth MUST be a whole number from 1 to 3, its layout one of `tree`, `nested` and `voronoi`, and the wiki card's width, when set, a whole number of pixels from 300 to 900.

title: An entities limit is a whole number of at least 1
statement: An entities limit MUST be a whole number of at least 1; the store refuses any other value, naming the table.
